project_intent.name: Story Auto
project_intent.purpose: Turn content.md narration into cinematic long-form storytelling videos with recoverable AI media generation.
project_intent.intended_use: Single-operator local production of original fictional YouTube storytelling videos.
project_intent.success_definition: A configured operator can plan, review, generate, resume, render, and package a 1080p story in hybrid_hook or full_video_ai mode with deterministic artifacts, per-request provenance, bounded spend, and no silent mode-violating fallback.
project_intent.non_goals: No YouTube upload, cloud queue/database/multi-user system, generic NLE, plugin framework, automatic music sourcing, or extra visual providers in V1.
project_intent.constraints: Separate from YouTube Auto; Google Flow visual provider; ElevenLabs/Typecast TTS; Gemini 3.5 Flash baseline; provider calls bounded and explicit; runtime/browser/secrets outside source control.

project_lifecycle.testing_strategy: Deterministic core/contract tests; provider page-fixture tests offline; tiny FFmpeg integration fixtures; bounded authorized live provider smoke tests; runtime artifact review may veto passing tests.
project_lifecycle.engineering_conventions: Modular monolith; provider-independent core; atomic/versioned artifacts; append-only generation attempts; CLI/application services canonical before UI; no runtime imports from YouTube Auto; typed provider failures and bounded retries.

safety_boundaries.runtime: Story Auto uses its own configurable runtime root, projects, cache/temp/logs/evidence, locks and dedicated Flow browser profile; tests use temporary roots.
safety_boundaries.production: No YouTube publishing. Large Flow batches and all full-video batches require explicit operator confirmation. One active production Flow-generation project per profile.
safety_boundaries.data: Project content and generated assets remain outside source control by default; selected/raw attempts are retained and not silently overwritten; diagnostics are sanitized.
safety_boundaries.secrets: Do not commit secrets. Credentials live in environment or Story Auto-specific secure storage; browser login is user-managed.
